description: Numbers of the map environment blend: how the light mode and the fog change when a map switches between its light settings. Values are Q12 (4096 = 1.0; fog distances Q12 metres). A mod changes it with a file of the same path in its own folder; objects are merged key by key, so the patch only needs the keys it changes.

light_mode_cross_fade.description: Light mode 1 -> 2 and 2 -> 1: the old grey layer fades out up to the pivot (to_dense_pivot / from_dense_pivot, Q12 of the fade), the new one fades in after it, faster by long_rate (Q12).

fog_by_alpha.description: Fog distance when the fog is off and the light mode is 1: interpolated through "distances" (Q12 metres) over the grey layer alpha 0..alpha_span. In every other case the fog distance is open_fog_distance.
